title: Keep state local instead of memoizing

slides.say: Before reaching for memo, check where your state lives.
Here a hover state sits at the top of the app. Every hover re-renders the whole big tree below.
Move it down into the component that uses it. Now a hover only re-renders that one card.

slides.text: Don’t lift transient state (forms, hover) higher than needed.
slides.say: Prefer local state. Do not lift transient state, like forms or hover, higher than necessary, or into a global store.
